name: Conflict-preserving narrative ledger
summary: A narrative journal remains trustworthy when it stores witnessed claims by source, links supporting and opposing evidence, and refuses to collapse unresolved testimony into one authoritative account.
player_action: The player compares accounts, marks a working hypothesis, and revises it when new evidence arrives.
system_response: The ledger updates relationships and confidence while retaining the parent claims, contradictions, and provenance.

conflicts_with: journal resolving a conflict without distinguishing evidence

failure_modes: A later correction rewrites its parent.
Two speakers are merged into one account.
Confidence rises through repetition of the same source.
The ledger mistakes a coherent story for a verified event.
accessibility: Expose source, relationship, and uncertainty in text as well as symbols.
Allow filtering without deleting contradictions from the underlying record.

smallest_playable_test.setup: Six claims from three sources describing one incident, including corroboration, dependency, one honest mistake, and one unresolved contradiction.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Players can state the best-supported account and separately name what remains unresolved after interruption and reload.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: The ledger is accurate but too administratively expensive to read.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Repetition, recency, or UI order promotes a claim without new distinguishing evidence.

notes: Requires a playable mystery and interruption test before promotion.
